name: Tai'jin
summary: At the Razor Hill barracks, Tai'jin guides young Darkspear priests in their spiritual traditions. She teaches the balance of light and shadow and rites such as the Hex of Weakness.

sections.title: Priestess of Razor Hill
sections.body: Tai'jin guides young priests from the Razor Hill barracks as they set out into Durotar. Orcs here turn chiefly to shamanism or warlock arts, while Darkspear trolls bring their communion with spirits and loas to the Horde. Tai'jin teaches the first principles of priesthood, the balance of light and shadow, and the spiritual heritage of troll culture.

faq.answer: Tai'jin is inside the Razor Hill Barracks in central Durotar, on the ground floor beside other class trainers.
Tai'jin teaches new priests spells, ranks, and abilities as they gain experience, including early instruction for troll initiates.

faq.q: Why is a troll priest stationed in an orc settlement?
aliases: why is taijin in razor hill
faq.answer: Razor Hill trains young Horde adventurers leaving the Valley of Trials and Sen'jin Village. Since orcs do not practice the priestly arts, Tai'jin brings Darkspear spiritual traditions to the settlement.

faq.q: What special rites does Tai'jin provide for troll priests?
faq.answer: Tai'jin guides Darkspear priests through introductory spiritual rites, including the Hex of Weakness, which channels ancestral curses.

angles.text: As a Horde priest training in Durotar, you learn from Tai'jin before heading to Orgrimmar's grand halls.
As a young Darkspear troll, you can learn distinctive spells from Tai'jin, including the Hex of Weakness.
